facts: North rose16 principal radiating divisions; south12
South rose rotated half-petal during1861restoration so mullions are on vertical/horizontalaxes
13th-century roses contain historic restoration panels; not all glass is medieval
Jacques Le Chevallier made distinct nonfigurative windows for nave clerestory, west transept wall and galleries; last installed1965
Do not put medieval figure patterns in every clerestory window
34 of41 chapel windows are ornamental or grisaille, chiefly pale patterned glass with colored borders, rather than a uniformly vivid figurative ensemble.
Choir chapel glass was restored by Antoine Lusson in the north from1862 and Alfred Gérente in the south in1863; nave chapel glazing followed in1864–1865.
The derived chapel atlases therefore retain actual prefire photographed grisaille and fine vegetal lead/paint patterns; the modeled chapel placement remains an interpretation.
